mapper.insert: insert into articles(id, user_id, slug, title, description, body, created_at, updated_at) values(#{article.id}, #{article.userId}, #{article.slug}, #{article.title}, #{article.description}, #{article.body}, #{article.createdAt}, #{article.updatedAt})
mapper.select: select A.id, A.user_id, A.slug, A.title, A.description, A.body, A.created_at, A.updated_at, T.id tag_id, T.name tag_name from articles A left join article_tags AT on A.id = AT.article_id left join tags T on T.id = AT.tag_id where A.id = #{id}

select A.id, A.user_id, A.slug, A.title, A.description, A.body, A.created_at, A.updated_at, T.id tag_id, T.name tag_name from articles A left join article_tags AT on A.id = AT.article_id left join tags T on T.id = AT.tag_id where A.slug = #{slug}
mapper.delete: delete from articles where id = #{id}; delete from article_tags where article_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, name from tags where name = #{tagName}
